name: Transcribe audio or video
description: Transcribe speech from an audio or video file owned by the current user, including hour-long videos: long recordings are segmented automatically and transcribed in order with timestamps. Uses attached media by default and can save a professional transcript pack (requested format plus SRT subtitles) as downloadable artifacts.

fileId.description: Optional id of an audio or video file owned by the user. Defaults to attached media.

language.description: Optional ISO language hint such as es or en.

prompt.description: Optional vocabulary or context hint for transcription.

format.description: Transcript artifact format. SRT/VTT carry timestamps; JSON carries text plus segments. Falls back to TXT when no timestamped segments exist. Default txt.

saveTranscript.description: Save the transcript pack as downloadable artifacts: the requested format plus SRT subtitles when timestamps exist. Default false.
